# Decisions

> **What:** material technical choices (ADR-): the options, the choice, and why
> **Read when:** before choosing a pattern, library, data shape or UI approach

### ADR-CAMP-001 · React and TypeScript web app

- **Owner:** product-owner
- **Scope:** project
- **Supports:** CAP-CAMP-001, CAP-CAMP-002, CAP-CAMP-003

**Options:** React + TypeScript · a low-code tool.
**Choice:** React + TypeScript.
**Why:** the team's current stack; the calendar needs custom interaction.
